aorist: A verb paradigm found in certain languages, usually an unmarked form or one that expresses the perfective or aorist aspect.
aoristic: Of, or relating to the aorist aspect.
aorta: The great artery which carries the blood from the heart to all parts of the body except the lungs; the main trunk of the arterial system.
aortal: Of or relating to the aorta.
aortic: Of or pertaining to the aorta or the aortic valve.
